note: The lane registry (BUILD-PLAN §4.8; D6 §3). A lane is declared here and proved by what its run observed (lanes/<id>/observed.json), never by this file. Budgets are 1.5 x the measured wall time rounded up to 30 s (D6 §16.5), and each stage share holds 1.5 x the slowest measured stage of its group (size_budgets.py, T12): measured on the release run of 2026-10-09 (every lane through page, -j 6, CPU, 2 threads per lane, machine load about 44 on 20 cores; runs/final/T12) and the final run's earlier lane runs; G00 keeps its estimate until it runs.

budget.reason: the gru forecaster reading its last state still improves at epoch 8 (valid mase 1.87 against the rnn floor's 1.70); at 60 epochs it wins beyond the valid noise (0.88 against the rnn floor's 0.99 and the linear floor's 1.00); a run takes seconds, well inside the stage time limits

changes.what: blocks: embedding, concat, gru(all), attention(pool), head(3) became embedding, concat, gru(return: last), head(3) — the catalog's standard gru forecaster reading its last state; the shape facts (three series, the nominal weather, the lag step, the autoregressive channel, horizon 3) and the bikeshare generator are unchanged
changes.why: attention(pool) is self-attention followed by a mean over the whole 24-step window: over a day-long window it averages away the hour of day, the data's main signal, so the rnn floor rightly won (runs/gen-landing, A37 stop); the last state carries the hour; A39 records it (BUILD-PLAN §4.8 superseded: embedding, concat, gru(return: last), head(3); budget 60/10)

budget.reason: the lstm still improves at epoch 8 (valid rmse 9.9, level with the linear floor's 9.8, both at their last epoch); at 30 epochs it wins beyond the valid noise (4.3 against 8.2); a run takes seconds, well inside the stage time limits

changes.what: tank's minutes_to_empty became the trailing 15-minute mean of the per-minute clipped time to empty (the level over that minute's net drain rate, 0-120); alarm and grade, the tank's other labels, are unchanged
changes.why: the instantaneous ratio suits a linear model reading the window's last step better than an lstm pooling its steps; a mean of a non-linear per-minute quantity is what the lstm family's step-then-pool reading is for, and a linear model over the window cannot form the ratio

changes.what: blocks: lstm(all), pool(mean), head became lstm(all), attention(pool), head — the lstm family's first catalog reducer in place of its alternative
changes.why: A38's L10 change left the catalog's attention block with no lane, and every catalog block must be declared by one (test_lanekit.py); of the two families that hold it (gru, lstm) this lane's window-averaged label is the one a pooled attention reads, and it seals the lstm beyond noise (4.3 against the linear floor's 8.2); ratified by A39 (BUILD-PLAN §4.8 superseded: lstm(all), attention(pool), head; budget 30/10)
